metadata.description: Themes for the Claude Code desktop app: colors and animated backdrops.

plugins.name: theme-library
plugins.description: Every theme in this library in one plugin, with /ccthemes to switch between them: a card you can filter by mode and style, search, preview and apply, a day and night mode that swaps twin themes by your clock, random, next, prev and off. Install this instead of several single themes.

plugins.name: abyss-lantern
plugins.description: The deep sea: sun shafts fading into the dark, glowing jellyfish, swaying kelp, bubbles and a passing school of fish. Dark.

plugins.name: arcade-hall
plugins.description: A pixel-art arcade at night: rows of cabinets playing their own little games, neon tubes and a patterned carpet. Dark.

plugins.name: art-deco
plugins.description: A 1920s deco poster: a gold sunburst over deep navy, stepped towers with gold-lined windows, concentric fan arcs and a shimmer of light crossing the gold. Dark.

plugins.name: aurora-field
plugins.description: Northern lights over a frozen lake ringed by pines, with twinkling stars and the odd shooting star. Dark.

plugins.name: autumn-forest
plugins.description: A forest in autumn at golden dusk: trees in red, orange and gold, leaves spiraling down, slanting light and a carpet of fallen leaves. Dark.

plugins.name: bamboo-grove
plugins.description: A bamboo grove in morning mist: tall green stalks in layers fading into haze, leaves swaying, slow light shafts and a few leaves falling. Light.

plugins.name: beacon-cove
plugins.description: An animated pixel-art theme that follows your clock: a lighthouse cape and sea from night through dawn, day and dusk, with a moving sun and moon, drifting clouds, a small boat and fireflies.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: An architect's blueprint: a fine grid on deep blue paper, with a gear, a house elevation, a beam section and a compass drawing that trace themselves in white line. Dark.

plugins.name: campfire
plugins.description: A night camp whose fire follows your 5-hour usage window and whose woodpile follows your context window: a roaring fire when plenty is left, embers when you are near the limit. A live theme. Dark.

plugins.name: cassette-futurism
plugins.description: A 1980s vision of the future: an amber monochrome console with a sweeping radar, a spectrum, scrolling data, turning cassette reels, blinking lights and scanlines. Dark.

plugins.name: chalk-observatory
plugins.description: A night sky in chalk on a slate board: a hilltop observatory whose telescope sweeps the sky, a crescent moon, twinkling stars, a constellation that draws itself and a shooting star. Dark.

plugins.name: circuit-board
plugins.description: A green circuit board: traces between pads and chips, bright pulses of light running along them and small LEDs blinking on their own beats. Dark.

plugins.name: circuit-board-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of circuit-board: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: cloud-sea
plugins.description: Sunrise above a sea of clouds: rolling banks of cloud drifting between dark peaks, a low sun, birds and a pastel sky from peach to blue. Light.

plugins.name: code-rain
plugins.description: Columns of falling glyphs in phosphor green, bright at the head and fading behind, dimmer under the chat. Dark.

plugins.name: code-rain-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of code-rain: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: colorblind-safe-dark
plugins.description: A dark theme whose colors stay apart for red-green and blue-yellow color blindness: blue and orange for added and removed, and a different lightness for each status. Colors only.

plugins.name: colorblind-safe-light
plugins.description: A light theme whose colors stay apart for red-green and blue-yellow color blindness: blue and orange for added and removed, and a different lightness for each status. Colors only.

plugins.name: constellations
plugins.description: A star map: rings and meridians of a celestial chart on deep blue, with constellations that draw themselves star to star, hold, then fade, and shooting stars. Dark.

plugins.name: contour-map
plugins.description: A topographic survey on warm paper: elevation lines draw themselves one height at a time around a flat basin. Light.

plugins.name: contour-map-night
plugins.description: The topographic survey in pale ink on blue-black paper, with the contours drawing themselves. Dark.

plugins.name: coral-reef
plugins.description: A sunlit coral reef: caustic light rippling over branching corals and sea fans, schools of bright fish, a clownfish in an anemone, a turtle gliding by and rising bubbles. Dark.

plugins.name: coral-reef-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of coral-reef: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: desert-night
plugins.description: A desert after dark: stars and a cold moon over blue-violet mesas, saguaros in silhouette, a campfire with sparks and an owl. Dark.

plugins.name: desert-noon
plugins.description: A bright desert at midday: red mesas, a pale sun, saguaros, heat shimmer, drifting dust and a tumbleweed. Light.

plugins.name: fog-valley
plugins.description: A misty mountain morning: blue ridges with fog drifting between them, low sun rays, a flock of birds and a far balloon. Light.

plugins.name: fog-valley-night
plugins.description: A misty mountain night: a moon over deep-blue ridges, pale fog drifting between them, fireflies in the pines and a sky lantern rising. Dark.

plugins.name: forest-floor
plugins.description: Moss, bark and fern: a green-brown dark theme and a pale lichen light one, with a fern-green accent. Colors only.

plugins.name: forest-trail
plugins.description: A pixel-art forest trail on a bright morning: sunbeams through layered trees, a winding dirt path, drifting mist, butterflies and falling leaves. Light.

plugins.name: forge-glow
plugins.description: A blacksmith forge at night: a stone wall, a furnace breathing orange light, an anvil with a glowing bar, hanging tools, sparks bursting off the anvil and embers rising. Dark.

plugins.name: glow-grove
plugins.description: A forest at night: giant mushrooms glowing teal, violet and pink at the edges, small ones lighting the floor, spores and fireflies drifting up through slow fog. Dark.

plugins.name: graphite
plugins.description: Neutral graphite grays with one steel-blue accent. Quiet and tool-like, light and dark, colors only.

plugins.name: greenhouse-rain
plugins.description: A glass greenhouse at dusk in the rain: streaks and drops running down the panes, big leaves and ferns swaying inside, warm hanging lamps and a drifting mist. Dark.

plugins.name: halftone-harbor
plugins.description: A two-ink halftone print of a harbor at sunset: a coral sun and its wake, blue water, a headland with a lighthouse, two boats. Light.

plugins.name: halftone-harbor-night
plugins.description: The halftone harbor printed on night-blue stock: an ember sun and pale-blue water in breathing dots. Dark.

plugins.name: halloween-night
plugins.description: A haunted hill on Halloween: a huge orange moon, a crooked manor with flickering windows, bats, drifting ghosts, glowing jack-o'-lanterns and fog among the gravestones. Dark. A vector companion to haunted-manor.

plugins.name: harvest-moon
plugins.description: A huge orange moon over a wheat field: wheat swaying in waves, hay bales and a barn in silhouette, crows crossing the moon and stars coming out. Dark.

plugins.name: haunted-manor
plugins.description: A pixel-art haunted manor under a huge moon: flickering windows, bats crossing the sky, a bare tree, drifting ground fog and an iron fence. Dark.

plugins.name: hearth
plugins.description: A warm theme: espresso and cream surfaces, terracotta accents, and a slow dusk backdrop with embers drifting up.

plugins.name: high-contrast-dark
plugins.description: Pure black and white with bright, saturated colors: text well past the AA bar on every surface, and strong borders. Dark, colors only.

plugins.name: high-contrast-light
plugins.description: Black on white with deep, saturated colors: text well past the AA bar on every surface, and strong borders. Light, colors only.

plugins.name: ink-wash
plugins.description: A sumi-e painting on rice paper: mountains in grey washes fading into mist, a pine branch, a lone boat, birds crossing and a red seal. Light.

plugins.name: isometric-room
plugins.description: A small isometric room at night: a desk with a glowing monitor and lamp, a plant, a bookshelf, a window onto a moonlit sky and a cat asleep on the rug. Dark.

plugins.name: koi-pond
plugins.description: A koi pond seen from above at dusk: orange and white koi gliding in slow loops, lily pads with pink flowers, ripples spreading and petals drifting on dark water. Dark.

plugins.name: lantern-festival
plugins.description: A lantern festival on a lake at night: paper lanterns rising into a starry sky, their warm light shimmering on the water, a pagoda and hills in silhouette. Dark.

plugins.name: low-orbit
plugins.description: A pixel-art view of space: a ringed gas giant, a small moon, a nebula, parallax stars, a passing ship and shooting stars. Dark.

plugins.name: meadow-hours
plugins.description: A rolling meadow that follows your clock: dawn, day, dusk and night, with a moving sun and moon, butterflies by day and fireflies after dark. Dark.

plugins.name: midnight-ink
plugins.description: Blue-black ink with pale paper-white text and a periwinkle accent. Dark, colors only.

plugins.name: moonlit-shore
plugins.description: A pixel-art beach at night: a moon and its glitter on the sea, stars, a campfire with sparks, a lantern boat and a crab. Dark.

plugins.name: neon-rain
plugins.description: A pixel-art city at night in the rain: towers with lit windows, buzzing neon signs, a wet street and a passing car. Dark.

plugins.name: neon-rain-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of neon-rain: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: new-year-fireworks
plugins.description: New Year's night over a city: rockets climbing and bursting in rings of colored sparks that fall as they fade, lit windows and stars through the smoke. Dark.

plugins.name: new-year-fireworks-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of new-year-fireworks: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: night-market
plugins.description: A pixel-art night market: strings of paper lanterns swinging over a lane, two glowing food stalls with rising steam, puddles that carry the light and a cat on a crate. Dark.

plugins.name: night-train
plugins.description: A night run seen from a carriage window: hills, town lights and telegraph poles sliding past under a thin moon. Dark.

plugins.name: origami-bay
plugins.description: A bay made of folded paper: layered paper waves that drift, an origami sailboat bobbing, folded cranes flying across a paper sun and clouds. Light.

plugins.name: oscilloscope
plugins.description: An oscilloscope screen: a glowing green graticule with a sine, a two-tone, a square and a triangle wave scrolling across and a cursor sweeping the display. Dark.

plugins.name: oscilloscope-calm
plugins.description: A calm version of oscilloscope: the same scene slowed to about 40% speed and softened under a veil, with heavier frosted panels, for when motion is distracting. Dark

plugins.name: paperback
plugins.description: A well-read paperback: cream pages, brown-black ink and an ink-blue accent. Light, colors only.

plugins.name: papercut-peaks
plugins.description: Five sheets of colored paper layered into mountains, each casting a soft shadow, with paper clouds and birds. Light.

plugins.name: papercut-peaks-night
plugins.description: The paper-cut mountains in deep indigo under a paper moon and cut-out stars. Dark.

plugins.name: pirate-cove
plugins.description: A pirate galleon in a sunny cove: a skull flag waving, gulls overhead, a far sail on the horizon and a treasure chest on a palm beach. Light.

plugins.name: pirate-cove-night
plugins.description: A pirate galleon under a full moon: a skull flag waving, lantern light at the stern, a far ship on the horizon and a treasure chest glowing on a palm islet. Dark.

plugins.name: pixel-cafe
plugins.description: A pixel-art cafe on a rainy night: rain running down a big window over blurred city lights, warm pendant lamps, a steaming cup on the counter and a cat asleep on the sill. Dark.

plugins.name: rainy-window
plugins.description: A night city seen through a rain-streaked window: soft bokeh lights, drops sliding down the glass, a warm lamp and a steaming mug. Dark.

plugins.name: reading-room
plugins.description: A cozy library at night: tall shelves of books, a floor lamp with dust turning in its light, a candle, a cup of tea and a sleeping cat. Dark.

plugins.name: real-sky
plugins.description: A lakeside view under the sky outside right now: the sun crosses from sunrise to sunset by your clock, and at night the moon crosses in its real phase for today, with stars and its reflection in the lake. A live theme. Dark.

plugins.name: retro-grid
plugins.description: A neon horizon: a slatted sun, wireframe mountains and a perspective grid that rolls toward you. Dark.

plugins.name: rice-terraces
plugins.description: A misty morning over stepped rice terraces: pale mountains, a low sun, green steps alternating with sky-colored water, drifting mist, a small hut and egrets in flight. Light.

plugins.name: risograph
plugins.description: A risograph print: fluorescent pink, teal and yellow shapes overprinting on warm paper with halftone dots and slight misregistration, drifting as if the ink were still wet. Light.

plugins.name: rooftop-garden
plugins.description: A pixel-art rooftop at golden hour: a pastel skyline, planters of sunflowers and tomatoes, string lights, birds on a wire and a kite. Light.

plugins.name: rooftop-garden-night
plugins.description: A pixel-art rooftop after dark: a moon and stars over a skyline of lit windows, glowing string lights, fireflies and a lantern. Dark.

plugins.name: sakura-drift
plugins.description: A spring dusk of pastel sky, misty hills and a blossoming tree, with petals drifting down. Light and dark.

plugins.name: snow-cabin
plugins.description: A winter night: a log cabin with a lit window, smoke curling from the chimney, snowy pines and snow falling in three layers. Dark.

plugins.name: snow-cabin-day
plugins.description: A winter noon: a pale blue sky and low sun, white hills, a log cabin with smoke from its chimney and snow falling in three layers. Light.

plugins.name: snow-station
plugins.description: A pixel-art train station in a night snowfall: snow drifting past warm lamps, a slow night train on the far track, a glowing clock on the gable and a bench under the canopy. Dark.

plugins.name: spooky-hollow
plugins.description: A haunted graveyard under a full moon: a dead tree with a swinging green lantern and a blinking owl, tilted tombstones, drifting ghosts and wisps, bats crossing the sky, a crooked house with a flickering window and a glowing pumpkin. Dark.

plugins.name: spring-rain
plugins.description: A soft spring rain over pale green hills: blossoming trees shedding petals, rain streaking through, puddles rippling under a pastel sky. Light.

plugins.name: stained-glass
plugins.description: A cathedral window at night: four arched lancets of jewel-colored panes in dark lead, a slowly turning rose window and light drifting across the glass. Dark.

plugins.name: station-window
plugins.description: A view from a space station: a thick bolted window frame, the curve of a sunlit Earth with drifting cloud bands, a sunrise on the limb, a passing satellite and a console strip of blinking lights. Dark.

plugins.name: summer-fireflies
plugins.description: A meadow at dusk: fireflies blinking and drifting over swaying grass, a thin moon, first stars and the last orange glow on the horizon. Dark.

plugins.name: sunny-shore
plugins.description: A pixel-art beach on a bright day: a pulsing sun, drifting clouds, a sparkling sea, rolling foam, palms, gulls and a crab. Light.

plugins.name: tide
plugins.description: A beach at dusk whose tide follows your 5-hour usage window: high water while plenty is left, then the sea draws back and leaves wet sand, rocks, tide pools and a stranded boat. A live theme. Dark.

plugins.name: tide-pool
plugins.description: Looking straight down into a rock pool: breathing anemones, starfish, rippling light, drops making rings and small fish. Dark.

plugins.name: torch-dungeon
plugins.description: A pixel-art dungeon wall: two flickering torches, a dark doorway with watching eyes, bats, a hopping slime and a treasure chest. Dark.

plugins.name: ukiyo-e-wave
plugins.description: A Japanese woodblock print: a great wave curling over scale-pattern swells, boats riding the water, a red sun and a snow-capped mountain on cream paper. Light.

plugins.name: weather-mood
plugins.description: A lighthouse on a rocky headland whose weather follows Claude: a clear calm night while it is idle, clouds and rain while it works (harder as the context window fills) and a flash of lightning when a tool call fails. A live theme. Dark.

plugins.name: weekly-sky
plugins.description: A lakeside cabin under a sky that crosses a whole day as your 7-day usage window is used: sunrise at the start of the week, noon in the middle, sunset as you near the limit and night when you reach it. A live theme. Dark.

plugins.name: windfarm-dusk
plugins.description: A peach and lilac evening over plum hills, with a low sun, drifting clouds, birds and a field of wind turbines turning at different speeds. Light.

plugins.name: winter-lights
plugins.description: A snowy night dressed for the holidays: strings of colored lights twinkling in three phases, lit fir trees and a cottage, falling snow and a bright moon. Dark.

plugins.name: woodcut-cabin
plugins.description: A winter print in two inks: a cut-line sky, hatched hills, black pines, a log cabin with one orange window, smoke and falling snow. Light.

plugins.name: woodcut-cabin-night
plugins.description: A winter print on night stock: cut-line sky, a moon, black pines edged in cream, a log cabin with one orange window, smoke and falling snow. Dark.

plugins.name: woodcut-harbor
plugins.description: A harbor in two inks: wavy cut-line water, a black headland with a striped lighthouse and orange lamp, a sailboat, gulls and a paper sun. Light.

plugins.name: woodcut-rain-city
plugins.description: A night city in the rain, cut in two inks on dark stock: black towers with cream windows, a hatched moon behind cloud, rain streaks and a wet street. Dark.
